parameters.content:
## Facebook Marketplace Listing & Price Extractor

**Actor:** [Facebook Marketplace Listing & Price Extractor](https://apify.com/nimbryxo-studio/facebook-marketplace-listing-and-price-extractor)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/facebook-marketplace-listing-and-price-extractor.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string)
- `startUrls` (array)
- `searchQueries` (array)
- `location` (string)
- `country` (string)
- `latitude` (number)
- `longitude` (number)
- `radiusKm` (integer)
- `category` (string)
- `categoryId` (string)
- `sortBy` (string)
- `minPrice` (number)

### Output fields
- `title` (Title)
- `price` (Price)
- `city` (City)
- `state` (State)
- `locationText` (Location)
- `condition` (Condition)
- `deliveryTypes` (Delivery)
- `seller` (Seller)
- `primaryPhotoUrl` (Photo)
- `listingUrl` (Listing URL)

description: Facebook Marketplace scraper: runs the Facebook Marketplace Listing & Price Extractor Apify Actor, returns title, price, city, state, locationText and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
